review_candidates.title: Benchmarks Officer
review_candidates.description: About EMMI The European Money Markets Institute (EMMI) is an international non-profit association based in Brussels. It develops and administers financial benchmarks, including Euribor. EMMI also contributes to market standards and industry dialogue through dedicated forums. EMMI is dedicated to supporting the smooth functioning and integration of European money markets by administering trusted benchmarks, driving market efficiency, and supporting a more resilient European financial system. Our values are : Transparency — we promote openness and clarity in all our activities; Harmonisation — we support the alignment of standards and practices across markets; Integrity — we act with independence, accountability and a strong sense of ethics; Operational excellence — we strive for the highest quality in our outputs through robust, resilient and efficient processes. More information: www.emmi-benchmarks.eu The European Money Markets Institute is seeking to recruit a Benchmarks Officer to contribute to the implementation and oversight of benchmark provisions, help maintain benchmark quality, and participate in the design and development of new products. The position is permanent, full-time and based in Brussels. You will be part of EMMI’s Operations Unit and report to its Head of Unit. The Operations Unit is responsible for all activities related to the provision of EMMI’s product lines, which currently include the euro zone’s most important critical financial benchmark, EURIBOR, its fallback rate, EFTERM, and the STEP commercial paper market label. These activities include the design and development of existing and new products, their governance and quality control, and their distribution. The Operations Unit also implements internal operational processes, oversees outsourced processes, interacts with contributing panel banks, and monitors, analyses and reports on conjunctural and structural developments in money markets, in particular in the euro area.   Key responsibilities In this role, you will contribute to: Controlling, monitoring and/or implementing the daily collection, calculation and publication processes of EMMI’s benchmarks; Controlling, monitoring and continuously enhancing the quality of the benchmarks, including designing and performing regular data quality checks; Maintaining and developing supporting systems; Identifying, designing and developing new products; Contributing to projects run to achieve EMMI’s strategic objectives.   You will also be responsible for: Monitoring and reporting on developments in the European money markets and commercial paper markets; Drafting relevant reports on EURIBOR and EFTERM developments; Performing data analysis in the ongoing monitoring and scheduled review of the EURIBOR methodology; Leading selected Operations Unit projects. Qualifications and experience The ideal candidate has: A Master’s degree, or a Bachelor’s degree plus 5 years of relevant experience, in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Law or another relevant field; Advanced knowledge of MS Office, in particular Word, Excel and PowerPoint; Experience working with large datasets; Experience with programming languages such as SQL, R or Python; Experience using visualisation tools such as Tableau; Excellent command of English and another EU language, both oral and written.   Skills You demonstrate the following skills: Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail; Ability to manage and lead projects and workstreams simultaneously; Ability to develop well-structured policies, procedures and technical documentation; Effective communication skills, with the ability to report and document activities clearly and concisely; Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team; Strong analytical skills to assess complex market, data and benchmark-related issues and propose pragmatic solutions.   Behavioural attributes At EMMI, we value candidates who demonstrate: Teamwork — working in an environment of trust, encouraging open exchange of information and valuing the debate of ideas; Accountability — taking responsibility for actions, decisions, outcomes and contributions; Results orientation — focusing on timely delivery, effective results and high-quality work; Learning and development — actively seeking to grow knowledge, skills and capabilities; Openness to change — challenging the status quo and embracing new ways of working for the long-term good of the organisation. How to apply Please send your application to recruitment@emmi-benchmarks.eu . Your application should include: Your CV; A motivational letter including salary expectations; Two references.   Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Incomplete applications cannot be considered.   Application deadline Please submit your complete application by Friday, 25 September 2026 .   Interview process Shortlisted candidates will be notified by Monday, 28 September 2026. First-round interviews will be held via Teams or in person between 29 September and 2 October 2026. Candidates progressing to the next stage will complete a personality test and prepare a presentation on a topic provided by EMMI. Second-round interviews will take place in person at the EMMI office, 56 Avenue des Arts, 1000 Brussels, on 12 and 13 October 2026.   Join EMMI as a Benchmarks Officer and contribute to the oversight, quality and development of benchmarks that support the functioning of European money markets. This is a permanent, full-time position based in Brussels, within a collaborative team working on EURIBOR, EFTERM, market monitoring, data analysis and product development. Apply by Friday, 25 September 2026 .
